about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm Zenky Setiawan, an Informatics undergraduate at Universitas Dehasen Bengkulu. I enjoy building applications that people actually use: from a QR Code-based digital museum platform (Smart Museum) and the EcoSphere environmental education app, to a personal finance app, marketplaces, and e-commerce websites.

Outside of class, I'm active in the DE CODE Bengkulu tech community as Vice Chairperson and previously led its graphic design team. Together with a lecturer, I also presented EcoSphere to high school students in Kepahiang. Right now I'm steering toward AI, machine learning, and RAG to become an AI Software Engineer, while sharing what I learn through tech content.
